name: Vedas & Hindu mythology LLM query assistant

mentions.name: Vedas & Hindu mythology LLM query assistant
mentions.description: This project explores applying LLMs to Indian Vedas, Puranas, and ancient Hindu religious texts: users type a problem or query into an input box and receive answers or resolution drawn from these scriptures. Still in the feasibility-exploration stage.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to understand the possibility and feasibility of LLM on Indian vedas and ancient hindu mythology. I am thinking like there is a input box where user will enter his problem,/query and get resolved with the help of Vedas, puran and old hindu religious books.
